colophon: Thus ends the Raksha Kala Kara Stava of the noble Arya Avalokiteshvara.

lines.2: The sins I have committed, gathered through body, speech, and mind:
lines.3: take them all away, O Lord; protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.4: In Nepal, for twelve years, the rains failed, a great terror:
lines.5: you who set King Narendradeva to the task, protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.6: In the mortal world and in the underworld, many beings suffer;
lines.7: you who increase their happiness, protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.8: Wherever you go, out of compassion for all beings,
lines.9: you lift them out of their sins: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.10: I am caught in the round of rebirth; how will I reach the far shore?
lines.11: You alone are the refuge there: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.12: You are made of all the gods, and made of all the Buddhas,
lines.13: and made of every perfection: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.14: You are ever made of compassion, ever made of protection,
lines.15: ever made of wisdom: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.16: Whatever deed anyone has done, by that very deed they are borne;
lines.17: whatever is wished for, you bestow: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.18: Until every being has reached Sukhavati,
lines.19: so long, in this pit of rebirth, protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.20: To the wise you are wisdom itself; to the suffering, the remover of suffering;
lines.21: to those who desire, you take the form of their desire: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.22: You are to be worshipped, O Lord of the world, bearing the very form of Om;
lines.23: you are ever to be honored: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.24: Master or servant, friend or enemy,
lines.25: you are merciful to all, everywhere: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.26: O Lokanatha, lord of the world, with a mind made devoted,
lines.27: I bow to you again and again: protect me, O Lokanayaka.
lines.28: I have many sorrows, beset by terrible hardships and dangers;
lines.29: have pity, O Avalokesha, and free me in an instant.
lines.30: Let your glance fall on me always; keep it so, and make it unending for me;
lines.31: may your compassion be upon me, and make my devotion unwavering.
